newsitem.title: USA: Oilex to acquire 225 Luling Field wells.
newsitem.headline: Oilex to acquire 225 Luling Field wells.

text.p: Oilex Inc said Wednesday it agreed to acquire 225 wells situated on 3,000 acres in the Luling Field in Luling, Texas, from privately owned BT Energy Inc for 1.5 million Oilex shares and $63,000.
It said this field will increase the number of wells it is producing with portable swabbing units to over 600.
All the wells are productive from the Austin Chalk formation at 2,500 feet, the company said. The estimated remaining in place reserves on the property are four million barrels.
With the wells and existing production, comes a field operation; swabbing units; vehicles; office building; shop and eleven acres of land where the field operations will be maintained.
The company said it expects to take over operations on March 15. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
